note: Frozen before any game it counts. No money. Only canonical forecasts generated at or after frozen_at count. Never edited mid-season; a changed rule is a new rule with its own frozen_at. Regular-season games only.
verdict_rule: Judged once, after the last 2026-27 regular-season game of the rule's sport: PASS only if at least 100 settled bets and the ISO-week block-bootstrap 95% interval of the return per 1-unit bet lies above 0; FAIL if at least 100 settled bets and the interval does not lie above 0; INCONCLUSIVE with fewer than 100. Any look before then is interim and is never a verdict.

rules.description: NHL winner: bet the canonical pick when its model probability is 65% or higher.
rules.price: the latest current bookmaker quote for the game's moneyline retrieved at or before the forecast

rules.description: NBA spread: bet the side opposite the canonical pick when its model probability is 65% or higher (the forecast must be at the bookmaker's line).
rules.price: the latest current bookmaker quote for the game's spread at the forecast's line retrieved at or before the forecast
